projectDir.description: Directory holding the project, relative to the directory the CLI runs in.

version-declared.name: PHP version is declared
version-declared.description: The project declares the PHP version Composer resolves against, and that version is no older than the configured floor.

minVersion.description: Oldest PHP version accepted. A declared version below this is a violation.

lockfile-committed.name: Composer dependencies are locked
lockfile-committed.description: The project commits `composer.lock`, so an install of the same commit resolves the same versions.
lockfile-committed.remediation:
Commit the lock file Composer writes:

```bash
composer update
git add composer.lock
```

A `^7.0` requirement resolves to whatever the registry serves that day, so without `composer.lock` an application installs differently on every deploy, and the versions that shipped are not the versions that were reviewed.

dependencies-constrained.name: Composer requirements are constrained
dependencies-constrained.description: Every package the manifest requires has a version constraint, instead of accepting whatever the registry serves.
